changes_made.explanation: Removed VQG/VQA as separate tasks since they are components of the dialogue generation process. Simplified output descriptions.
Consolidated related metrics (relevance/informativeness variants) and added missing efficiency metric. Removed implementation details that aren't evaluation metrics.

methods: NLI‑based scoring of relevance and informativeness

changes_made.explanation: Simplified model description and normalized method description. The NLI model is used post-generation to evaluate the quality of generated rationales.

guideline: Annotators rated relevance (1-5 scale: very irrelevant to very relevant) and informativeness (1-5 scale: very uninformative to very informative) following specific instructions about task context
Annotators judged procedural mistake detection accuracy by answering whether the procedure was successfully completed and providing confidence ratings (1-5 scale)

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated guideline descriptions and added confidence as an explicit evaluation criterion used in human evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on procedural mistake detection with generated rationales (self-dialogue of questions and answers). While VQG/VQA are components, the main NLG task is dialogue generation for rationalization. The extraction was generally accurate but needed consolidation of similar items and removal of implementation details.
